cn_steps: 启用实验性 `Field System`（编辑器模块 `FieldSystemEditor`）。运行时场求解在引擎模块 `FieldSystemEngine`，游戏 `Build.cs` 依赖后者而不是把 Editor 模块打进包装。
先有 Chaos `Geometry Collection`：静态网格转成几何集合资产并放进关卡。再从 Place Actors 拖入 `Field System Actor`（`AFieldSystemActor` / `UFieldSystemComponent`）。
在场 Actor 的 Construction 里组解析树：例如 `Radial Falloff` 包 `Radial Vector` 或 `Uniform Vector`，外层再套 `Culling Field`；意图选 `Strain`、`Dynamic State`、`Linear Force` 等，对准破碎件而不是普通 Static Mesh。
把几何集合的 `Object Type` 设为可模拟，PIE 里走进场半径应看到外力/应变；没有反应时检查场 Intent、Falloff 半径是否包住聚类，以及是否启用了 Chaos 破坏。
蓝图节点 `Apply Strain` / `Apply Physics Field` / `Apply Linear Force` 可在运行时往同一 `UFieldSystemComponent` 喂场；编辑器里的场可视化只来自 `FieldSystemEditor`。
`FieldSystemEditor` 只进 `*Editor.Build.cs`。接口标 Experimental，场节点图可能随夜构建改名。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Field System` (editor module `FieldSystemEditor`). Runtime evaluation lives in engine module `FieldSystemEngine` — game `Build.cs` depends on that, not the editor module.
Convert a static mesh to a Chaos `Geometry Collection` and place it. Then drop a `Field System Actor` (`AFieldSystemActor` / `UFieldSystemComponent`) from Place Actors.

Build a construction graph: e.g. `Radial Falloff` wrapping `Radial Vector` or `Uniform Vector`, optionally inside a `Culling Field`. Set intent to `Strain`, `Dynamic State`, or `Linear Force` aimed at fractured pieces, not a regular Static Mesh.
Set the collection to simulated and PIE-walk into the radius; you should see force/strain. If nothing happens, check intent, falloff radius vs. clusters, and that Chaos destruction is on.
Blueprint `Apply Strain` / `Apply Physics Field` / `Apply Linear Force` can feed the same `UFieldSystemComponent` at runtime. Viewport field gizmos come only from `FieldSystemEditor`.
Keep `FieldSystemEditor` in `*Editor.Build.cs` only. Experimental — field node names can change on nightlies.
note_cn: 给几何集合喂解析场，不是体积雾，也不是普通力场组件替代品。
note_en: Analytic fields for geometry collections, not volume fog and not a generic force-component stand-in.

cn_steps: 启用 `File Logging Analytics Provider`（模块 `FileLogging`）。它实现 `IAnalyticsProvider`，把 `RecordEvent` 写到本机文件，不连 Adjust / ET / Swrve。
在 `Config/DefaultEngine.ini` 的 `[Analytics]` 设置 `ProviderModuleName=FileLogging`（可再配 `FileLogging` 段指定目录）。未写 Provider 时 `UAnalyticsBlueprintLibrary` 的调用会 silently 丢掉。
开局调用 `Start Session`，玩法处 `Record Event` / `Record Event with Attributes`，退出 `End Session` 并 `Flush Events`。C++ 走 `FAnalytics::Get().GetDefaultConfiguredProvider()`。
PIE 后打开项目 `Saved/Analytics`（或配置的路径）核对 JSON/日志行是否带上事件名与属性；多会话应生成新文件或追加，而不是空目录。
Shipping 前换成真实 Provider；本模块可进包但只适合本地调试。游戏 `Build.cs` 一般只依赖 `Analytics` / `AnalyticsBlueprintLibrary`，不必直接链 `FileLogging`。
en_steps: Enable `File Logging Analytics Provider` (module `FileLogging`). It implements `IAnalyticsProvider` and writes `RecordEvent` to disk — not Adjust, ET, or Swrve.
In `Config/DefaultEngine.ini` under `[Analytics]` set `ProviderModuleName=FileLogging` (optional `[FileLogging]` path). Without a Provider, `UAnalyticsBlueprintLibrary` calls drop silently.
Call `Start Session` at boot, `Record Event` / `Record Event with Attributes` in gameplay, then `End Session` and `Flush Events`. C++ uses `FAnalytics::Get().GetDefaultConfiguredProvider()`.
After PIE, inspect `Saved/Analytics` (or your configured folder) for JSON/log lines with event names and attributes. New sessions should create or append files, not leave the folder empty.
Swap to a real provider before shipping. This module can cook but is for local debug. Game `Build.cs` usually depends on `Analytics` / `AnalyticsBlueprintLibrary`, not `FileLogging` directly.
note_cn: 磁盘落盘的 Analytics 后端，不是通用日志 `UE_LOG`。
note_en: Disk-backed Analytics provider, not a general `UE_LOG` logger.

cn_steps: 启用开发者插件 `File Sandbox`（`FileSandboxCore` + `FileSandboxUI`）并重启。它给编辑器套一层可重定向的 `IPlatformFile`，不是运行时 VFS。
用 `FileSandboxUI` 指定沙盒根目录（独立于工程 `Content/`）。之后经沙盒 API 的读写作到该根下，避免实验工具直接改工程资产。
编辑器工具模块依赖 `FileSandboxCore`，通过沙盒文件系统打开/保存临时包、导出缓存；不要对 `GFileManager` 的全局根做假设。
验证：在沙盒里新建/改文件后，工程 `Content` 与源码控制应保持干净，文件只出现在沙盒根。退出或关闭沙盒后，工具不得再写项目目录。
`FileSandboxUI` 与 `FileSandboxCore` 都不要进 Game Target；Shipping 包没有这套编辑器隔离。
en_steps: Enable developer plugin `File Sandbox` (`FileSandboxCore` + `FileSandboxUI`) and restart. It wraps editor I/O in a redirectable `IPlatformFile`, not a runtime VFS.
Use `FileSandboxUI` to pick a sandbox root outside project `Content/`. Sandbox API reads/writes land there so experimental tools do not mutate project assets.
Editor tool modules depend on `FileSandboxCore` and open/save temp packages or export caches through that filesystem; do not assume `GFileManager`’s global root.
Verify: files created in the sandbox appear only under the sandbox root; `Content` and source control stay clean. After closing the sandbox, tools must not write the project tree.
Keep `FileSandboxUI` and `FileSandboxCore` off Game targets; shipping builds have no editor isolation layer.
note_cn: 编辑器写盘隔离层，不是 Pak/IoStore 沙盒，也不是内容浏览器过滤器。
note_en: Editor write isolation, not Pak/IoStore sandboxing and not a Content Browser filter.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `File System Toolset`（`FileSystemToolset`，测试 `FileSystemToolsetTests`），并打开 `Toolset Registry` / 编辑器 AI（MCP）会话。
助手应列出读文件、写文本、HTTPS 下载等工具；在对话里让它读取工程内一个已知文本路径，确认返回内容而不是通用「搜索 Details」。
写文本只应落在工具允许的工作区路径；让它改一个临时 `.txt` 后用资源管理器核对，不要授权整个磁盘根。
HTTPS 下载用于拉公开文档/清单，检查输出日志里的 URL 与落地文件；证书失败时看引擎 HTTP 模块，不是蓝图组件。
`FileSystemToolsetTests` 只在自动化里跑。不要把 `FileSystemToolset` 写进游戏 `Build.cs`；Shipping 不需要 AI 读盘工具。
en_steps: Enable experimental `File System Toolset` (`FileSystemToolset`, tests `FileSystemToolsetTests`) and open `Toolset Registry` / an editor AI (MCP) session.
The assistant should list read-file, write-text, and HTTPS-download tools. Ask it to read a known in-project text path and confirm the contents — not a generic Details search.
Writes must stay inside allowed workspace paths. Have it patch a temp `.txt` and verify on disk; do not grant the whole drive root.
Use HTTPS download for a public doc/manifest; check Output Log URL and the saved file. Cert failures are the engine HTTP stack, not a Blueprint component.
Run `FileSystemToolsetTests` only under automation. Do not add `FileSystemToolset` to a game `Build.cs`; shipping games do not need AI disk tools.
note_cn: 给编辑器 AI 的读写/下载工具，不是 `IFileManager` 游戏存档 API。
note_en: Editor-AI read/write/download tools, not `IFileManager` save-game APIs.

cn_steps: 启用 `Firebase`（模块 `Firebase`）。它走 Firebase Cloud Messaging 远程推送，不是 Analytics 也不是 Firestore 全套 SDK。
Android 把 `google-services.json` 放到项目 Android 构建目录并在 UPL/Gradle 里让插件读到；iOS 放入 `GoogleService-Info.plist`。控制台打开 Cloud Messaging。
打包到真机，启动后向 Firebase 注册并拿到设备 token（看 Output Log / 插件回调）。用 Firebase 控制台发一条测试通知，应用在后台时应弹出系统通知。
前台/点击通知的处理写在游戏模块对 `Firebase` 的回调里（打开指定关卡、深链）；不要在蓝图里找「Firebase 组件」当 Actor 挂件。
游戏 `Build.cs` 仅在移动目标依赖 `Firebase`。桌面 PIE 收不到 FCM；凭证填错会注册失败而不是静默启用。
en_steps: Enable `Firebase` (module `Firebase`). It is Firebase Cloud Messaging for remote notifications — not Analytics and not the full Firestore SDK.
Place Android `google-services.json` where the Android build/UPL/Gradle can see it, and `GoogleService-Info.plist` on iOS. Turn on Cloud Messaging in the Firebase console.
Ship to a device, register, and capture the FCM token (Output Log / plugin callback). Send a test message from the console; a backgrounded app should show a system notification.
Handle foreground/tap payloads in game-module callbacks (open a map, deep link). There is no `Firebase` actor component to drop in the level.
Depend on `Firebase` only on mobile game targets. Desktop PIE will not receive FCM; bad credentials fail registration rather than silently working.
note_cn: 移动端远程通知桥，不是通用后端 BaaS 插件。
note_en: Mobile remote-notification bridge, not a full Firebase BaaS plugin.

cn_steps: 同时启用 `Electra Player` 与 `FLAC audio decoder for Electra`（模块 `FlacDecoderElectra`）后重启。本插件只向 Electra 注册 FLAC 解码器，不新建播放器窗口。
准备 `.flac`（或容器内 FLAC 音轨）。创建 `File Media Source` 指向该文件，再创建 `Media Player`，播放器后端选 Electra 而不是 WMF/`Android Media`。
把 `Media Texture` 可省略（纯音频）；用 `Media Sound Component` 或 Media Player 的音轨输出监听。蓝图 `Open Source` → `Play`。
Output Log 应出现 Electra 挂上 `FlacDecoderElectra`；若提示 codec 不支持，确认 Player 不是 WMF，且文件确实是 FLAC 而非 ALAC/Opus。
游戏 `Build.cs` 通常不必直接依赖 `FlacDecoderElectra`；插件启用后 Electra 工厂会加载它。不要把它当成 `Audio Mixer` 的解码器去播 `USoundWave`。
en_steps: Enable both `Electra Player` and `FLAC audio decoder for Electra` (module `FlacDecoderElectra`) and restart. The plugin only registers a FLAC decoder with Electra — no new player UI.
Point a `File Media Source` at a `.flac` (or a container with a FLAC track). Create a `Media Player` and select Electra, not WMF/`Android Media`.
Skip `Media Texture` for audio-only; listen via `Media Sound Component` or the player’s audio bus. Blueprint: `Open Source` then `Play`.
Output Log should show Electra attaching `FlacDecoderElectra`. If the codec is unsupported, the player is probably WMF, or the file is ALAC/Opus rather than FLAC.
Game `Build.cs` usually need not list `FlacDecoderElectra`; Electra’s factory loads it when the plugin is on. It does not decode `USoundWave` through Audio Mixer.
note_cn: Electra 的 FLAC 编解码后端，不是 Sound Cue / MetaSound 解码器。
note_en: Electra FLAC codec backend, not a Sound Cue / MetaSound decoder.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `Floating Properties`（模块 `FloatingProperties`）并重启。它把 Details 里钉住的属性画在活动视口上，不是新的属性编辑器。
选中关卡 Actor，在 Details 属性旁使用钉到视口 / floating 控件（插件提供的 pin）。视口应出现可拖动的浮动行，改数值应与 Details 双向同步并可撤销。
切到正交/透视视口验证 overlay 跟的是「活动视口」；切换所选 Actor 时浮动条应换成新对象属性，而不是残留上一个。
适合调灯光强度、变换、VP 场景参数时不离开视口。不要把 `FloatingProperties` 加进游戏 `Build.cs`。
Experimental：钉住状态可能不进版本控制；Shipping 包没有视口 overlay。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Floating Properties` (module `FloatingProperties`) and restart. It draws pinned Details rows on the active viewport — it is not a second property editor.
Select a level actor and pin a Details property to the viewport via the plugin’s pin control. A draggable overlay row should appear; edits sync both ways with Details and undo.
Confirm the overlay follows the *active* viewport (ortho vs. perspective). Changing selection should swap the floating rows, not leave the previous object’s properties.
Use it to tweak light intensity, transforms, or VP scene values without leaving the viewport. Do not add `FloatingProperties` to a game `Build.cs`.
Experimental: pin state may not be source-controlled. Shipping builds have no viewport overlay.
note_cn: 视口上的 Details 钉钉条，不是 Runtime 调试 HUD。
note_en: Pinned Details rows on the viewport, not a runtime debug HUD.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `Flow Production Tracking`（模块 `Shotgrid`，描述符仍是 `Shotgrid.uplugin`）。这是 Autodesk Flow（原 Shotgun/ShotGrid）的编辑器集成，不是运行时在线子系统。
安装/配置 Flow Python Toolkit（`tk-unreal`）与站点 URL、脚本密钥或 SSO。编辑器启动后用插件登录 Flow 项目，而不是在关卡里放组件。
从 Flow 面板 Load 当前 Shot 对应的 Unreal 工程/关卡；完成镜头后 Publish 网格、关卡或 Sequencer 资产，任务状态应回到 Flow 网页。
核对 Publish 版本号、路径模板与 Toolkit schema 一致；失败先看 Output Log 里 Shotgun/Flow API 错误和 Python 引擎是否加载 `tk-unreal`。
只给制片管线用：`Shotgrid` 不要进游戏 Target。凭证放在本机 Toolkit 配置，不要写进要提交的 `DefaultEngine.ini`。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Flow Production Tracking` (module `Shotgrid`, descriptor still `Shotgrid.uplugin`). It is Autodesk Flow (formerly Shotgun/ShotGrid) for the editor, not a runtime online subsystem.
Install/configure the Flow Python Toolkit (`tk-unreal`) with site URL and script key or SSO. Log into the Flow project from the editor plugin — do not place a level component.
Load the Unreal map for the current shot from the Flow panel; after the shot, Publish meshes, levels, or Sequencer assets and confirm the version appears on the Flow web task.
Publish paths must match the Toolkit schema. On failure, read Shotgun/Flow API errors in the Output Log and confirm `tk-unreal` loaded in the Python engine.
Pipeline-only: keep `Shotgrid` off game targets. Store credentials in local Toolkit config, not in a committed `DefaultEngine.ini`.
note_cn: ShotGrid/Flow 制片登录与 Publish，不是过场动画工具。
note_en: ShotGrid/Flow login and publish, not a cinematic authoring tool.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `Fracture`（模块 `FractureEngine`），并保持 Chaos 几何集合 / Fracture Editor 相关插件开启。本模块给断裂编辑器提供引擎侧切割与聚类，不是单独的「破碎组件」面板。
选中静态网格，生成 `Geometry Collection` 资产并替换关卡里的网格。切到 `Fracture` 模式（模式工具栏），用 Uniform / Cluster / Slice / Plane 切块。
调 `Num Voronoi Sites`、最小体积、嵌入与聚类层次后 `Fracture`；视口应看到彩色碎块。保存几何集合资产，否则 PIE 仍是未切的整体。
把集合 `Object Type` 设为模拟，加场或碰撞触发应变；PIE 中应沿预切面裂开。运行时依赖 Chaos / `GeometryCollectionEngine`，`FractureEngine` 主要服务编辑器切分结果。
不要把 `FractureEngine` 误当成 Apex Destruction。编辑器切分数据写在几何集合资产里，Shipping 播的是已切好的集合，不是 Fracture 模式 UI。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Fracture` (module `FractureEngine`) and keep Chaos geometry-collection / Fracture Editor plugins on. This module supplies engine-side cut/cluster for the Fracture editor — not a standalone “break component” panel.
Select a static mesh, create a `Geometry Collection` asset, and swap it into the level. Enter `Fracture` mode and cut with Uniform / Cluster / Slice / Plane.
Tune Voronoi site count, min volume, embed, and cluster hierarchy, then Fracture. Colored pieces should appear; save the collection or PIE still uses the uncut solid.

Set object type to simulated and trigger strain via a field or impact; PIE should split along the pre-cut faces. Runtime uses Chaos / `GeometryCollectionEngine`; `FractureEngine` mainly authors the cuts.
This is not Apex Destruction. Cut data lives on the geometry collection; shipping plays the authored collection, not the Fracture-mode UI.
note_cn: 几何集合的预切编辑器后端，不是运行时随机碎裂求解器。
note_en: Authoring backend for pre-cut geometry collections, not a runtime random-shatter solver.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `Full Body IK`（模块 `FullBodyIK` 与 `PBIK`）。这是动画图 / Control Rig 的全身 IK 求解器，不是角色组件。
打开骨架的 `AnimBP`，在 AnimGraph 加入 `Full Body IK`（PBIK）节点，接在输出 Pose 前。指定 Root、解算迭代次数，并为手/脚/头添加 Effector（骨名 + `Transform` 目标）。
用脚效应器对地面、手对道具；PIE 或预览网格上应看到整条链（脊柱、骨盆）补偿，而不是只有末端骨旋转。权重过大导致抖动时降低 Alpha 或加约束。
Control Rig 里同样有 `PBIK` 节点，适合绑定层；运行时角色通常用 AnimBP 节点。旧 `FullBodyIK` 节点与 `PBIK` 并存，新项目优先 PBIK。
游戏 `Build.cs` 依赖 `PBIK`（需要旧求解器再加 `FullBodyIK`）。不要把本插件当物理资产（Physics Asset）替代。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Full Body IK` (modules `FullBodyIK` and `PBIK`). It is a full-body IK solver for AnimGraph / Control Rig, not a character component.
In the skeleton’s `AnimBP`, add a `Full Body IK` (PBIK) node before Output Pose. Set the root, iteration count, and effectors (bone name + target `Transform`) for hands/feet/head.
Drive foot effectors to the floor and hands to props. Preview/PIE should show spine/pelvis compensation, not just end-bone rotation. If it jitters, lower alpha or add constraints.
Control Rig also has a `PBIK` node for rigs; runtime characters usually use the AnimBP node. Legacy `FullBodyIK` coexists — prefer PBIK on new work.
Game `Build.cs` depends on `PBIK` (add `FullBodyIK` only if you still call the old solver). This plugin does not replace a Physics Asset.
note_cn: PBIK 全身 IK 节点，不是 Two Bone IK，也不是物理布娃娃。
note_en: PBIK full-body node, not Two Bone IK and not a physics ragdoll.

cn_steps: 启用 `Functional Testing Editor`（模块 `FunctionalTestingEditor`）。它给 `AFunctionalTest` / Screenshot 等功能测试补编辑器放置、细节定制与会话集成，运行时测试框架仍是 `FunctionalTesting`。
在测试关卡放置 `Functional Test` Actor（或派生），填 `Test Label`、准备/完成延迟、成功条件（例如 Actor 到达、查询通过）。
用编辑器扩展设截图对比基准、选中测试 Actor 的细节定制；不要把测试逻辑写在普通关卡蓝图 Event BeginPlay 里却从不 `Finish Test`。
打开 Session Frontend → Automation，过滤 `Functional` 或你的测试名，PIE/编辑器会话跑用例。失败看 Message Log 与截图 diff，而不是游戏 HUD。
`FunctionalTestingEditor` 只进 Editor Target；CI 用 `-ExecCmds="Automation RunTests ..."`。Shipping 客户端不要依赖本插件。
en_steps: Enable `Functional Testing Editor` (module `FunctionalTestingEditor`). It adds placement, Details customization, and session integration for `AFunctionalTest` / screenshot tests; the runtime harness remains `FunctionalTesting`.
Place a `Functional Test` actor (or subclass) in a test map. Set `Test Label`, prepare/finish delays, and success conditions (actor reached, query passed).
Use the editor extras for screenshot baselines and test-actor Details. Do not put test logic only in level BeginPlay without ever calling `Finish Test`.
In Session Frontend → Automation, filter `Functional` or your test name and run in PIE/editor. Failures show in Message Log and screenshot diffs, not the game HUD.
`FunctionalTestingEditor` is Editor-target only. CI uses `-ExecCmds="Automation RunTests ..."`. Do not depend on this plugin in a shipping client.
note_cn: 功能测试的编辑器壳，真正的 `AFunctionalTest` API 在 `FunctionalTesting`。
note_en: Editor shell for functional tests; `AFunctionalTest` APIs live in `FunctionalTesting`.

cn_steps: 这是 `Game Features` 的 `TestConfig` 同伴插件（模块 `GameFeaturesTests`），用于跑 GFP 加载/激活自动化，不是给玩家开的功能包。
同时启用 `Game Features`。用 Session Frontend 或 `Automation RunTests` 过滤 `GameFeatures` / `GameFeaturesTests` 相关用例。
测试会装载临时 Game Feature 插件、检查 `UGameFeaturesSubsystem` 状态机（Registered → Loaded → Active）再卸载；失败时看哪一步 Status 卡住。
不要把本插件列进项目默认启用列表给 Shipping；仅 Editor/Program 测试目标加载。
写自己的 GFP 测试时参考这些用例如何创建 `UGameFeatureData` 与 Action，而不是复制到游戏模块。
en_steps: This is the `TestConfig` companion for `Game Features` (module `GameFeaturesTests`): automation for GFP load/activate, not a player-facing feature pack.
Keep `Game Features` enabled. In Session Frontend or `Automation RunTests`, filter `GameFeatures` / `GameFeaturesTests`.
Tests mount a temporary Game Feature plugin, walk `UGameFeaturesSubsystem` (Registered → Loaded → Active), then unload. Failures usually stick on one of those states.
Do not enable this plugin by default in shipping projects; load it only on Editor/Program test targets.
When writing your own GFP tests, copy how these cases build `UGameFeatureData` and actions — do not ship the test module in the game.
note_cn: GameFeatures 的自动化同伴，不会给项目增加可玩功能。
note_en: Automation companion for GameFeatures; it does not add playable features.

cn_steps: 启用实验性 `Game Features Toolset`（模块 `GameFeaturesToolset`），并打开 `Toolset Registry` / 编辑器 AI；同时保持 `Game Features` 开启。
助手应出现列出、检查、创建 Game Feature Plugin 的工具。让它列出当前已注册 GFP，对照 `UGameFeaturesSubsystem` 或插件目录，而不是打开空白关卡。
用「创建」工具生成一个最小 GFP（含 `UGameFeatureData`）；内容浏览器/`Plugins` 目录应出现新插件，状态为 Registered 或可 Load。
再让助手 Inspect 该 GFP 的 Actions（加组件、数据包等）。创建失败时看路径是否落在允许的 Plugins 目录、以及 GameFeatures 是否启用。
不要把 `GameFeaturesToolset` 打进游戏包；它只替 AI 改工程插件树。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Game Features Toolset` (module `GameFeaturesToolset`) plus `Toolset Registry` / editor AI, and keep `Game Features` on.
The assistant should expose list/inspect/create Game Feature Plugin tools. Ask it to list registered GFPs and compare with `UGameFeaturesSubsystem` or the Plugins folder — not an empty map.
Use create to scaffold a minimal GFP (with `UGameFeatureData`). A new plugin should appear under `Plugins` and show Registered or loadable.
Inspect its Actions (add component, data packs). If create fails, check the target Plugins path and that GameFeatures is enabled.
Do not cook `GameFeaturesToolset` into the game; it only lets the AI mutate the project plugin tree.
note_cn: AI 侧的 GFP 增删查，真正加载激活仍走 `GameFeatures` 子系统。
note_en: AI list/inspect/create for GFPs; load/activate still goes through the `GameFeatures` subsystem.

cn_steps: 启用 `Game Features`（运行时 `GameFeatures`，编辑器 `GameFeaturesEditor`）。它管理可热加载的模块化 `Game Feature Plugin`（GFP）。
用编辑器向导或在 `Plugins/` 下建 GFP：主资产 `UGameFeatureData`，在 Actions 里加 `Add Cheats`、`Add Components`、Data Registry、World Partition Data Layer 等。
默认状态在 `DefaultGame.ini` / GameFeature 插件列表里设为 Registered、Loaded 或 Active。运行时用 `UGameFeaturesSubsystem` 的 `LoadGameFeaturePlugin` / `ChangeGameFeatureTargetState` 切到 `Active`。
PIE 验证：激活后 Action 声明的组件应出现在目标 Actor 上，停用后应卸下。依赖未加载的 GFP 会导致 Action 空跑。
游戏模块 `Build.cs` 只加 `GameFeatures`；`GameFeaturesEditor` 仅 `*Editor.Build.cs`。每个可玩 DLC/季节内容一个 GFP，不要把所有玩法塞进同一个 Feature Data。
en_steps: Enable `Game Features` (runtime `GameFeatures`, editor `GameFeaturesEditor`). It manages hot-loadable modular Game Feature Plugins (GFPs).
Create a GFP via the editor wizard or under `Plugins/`. The primary asset is `UGameFeatureData`; add Actions such as `Add Cheats`, `Add Components`, Data Registry, or World Partition Data Layers.

Set default state in `DefaultGame.ini` / the Game Feature list (Registered, Loaded, or Active). At runtime call `UGameFeaturesSubsystem` `LoadGameFeaturePlugin` / `ChangeGameFeatureTargetState` toward `Active`.
In PIE, components declared by Actions should appear on target actors when active and detach when deactivated. Depending on an unloaded GFP makes Actions no-ops.
Game `Build.cs` lists `GameFeatures` only; `GameFeaturesEditor` stays in `*Editor.Build.cs`. One GFP per DLC/season slice — do not dump all gameplay into a single Feature Data asset.
note_cn: 模块化功能包的加载状态机，不是 Gameplay Ability 系统本身。
note_en: Load-state machine for modular feature packs, not the Gameplay Ability System itself.

cn_steps: 启用 `Game Input Base`（运行时 `GameInputBase`，编辑器 `GameInputBaseEditor`）。它封装 Microsoft GameInput 的设备枚举与读输入，需搭配平台插件（如 `Game Input (Windows)`）才有真实设备。
Windows/GDK 目标同时启用对应平台 GameInput 插件。Enhanced Input 的 `Input Device` 后端可走 GameInput，而不是 RawInput/XInput 各写一套。
插上手柄/方向盘，PIE 看设备出现在 GameInput 设备列表（编辑器 `GameInputBaseEditor` 辅助）。`FKey` 事件应进 PlayerController / Enhanced Input Mapping Context。
振动、触摸板、方向盘轴从 GameInput 设备对象读，不要假设 XInput 的 4 手柄上限。设备被系统占用时（Game Bar、其它全屏游戏）枚举会空。
游戏 `Build.cs` 依赖 `GameInputBase`；`GameInputBaseEditor` 只进编辑器。非微软平台不会凭空冒出 GameInput 设备。
en_steps: Enable `Game Input Base` (runtime `GameInputBase`, editor `GameInputBaseEditor`). It wraps Microsoft GameInput device enumeration and reads; pair it with a platform plugin such as `Game Input (Windows)` for real devices.
On Windows/GDK also enable the matching GameInput platform plugin. Enhanced Input can use GameInput as the device backend instead of separate RawInput/XInput paths.
Plug in a pad/wheel and PIE: the device should list via GameInput (`GameInputBaseEditor` helps in-editor). `FKey` events should reach the PlayerController / Enhanced Input mapping context.
Read rumble, touchpad, and wheel axes from the GameInput device object; do not assume XInput’s four-pad cap. Enumeration is empty if Game Bar or another fullscreen app owns the device.
Game `Build.cs` depends on `GameInputBase`; `GameInputBaseEditor` is editor-only. Non-Microsoft platforms will not magically grow GameInput devices.
note_cn: GameInput 设备层，不是 Enhanced Input 的 Mapping Context 编辑器。
note_en: GameInput device layer, not the Enhanced Input mapping-context editor.
